title: Harden resumable firmware uploads and reconcile current code, evidence, and backlog

firmware.note: No firmware binary changed; the upload API and evidence handling were tested with synthetic service fixtures.

execution.environment: macOS Apple Silicon and GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest; Python 3

checks.name: local_platform_tests
checks.detail: 249 tests; OK; no skips in the local run

checks.name: resumable_upload_service_round_trip
checks.detail: Contiguous chunks, resume metadata, final hash and normal artifact publication

checks.name: resumable_upload_failure_rollback
checks.detail: Simulated fsync failure restored staging and metadata to the last committed offset

checks.name: abandoned_upload_gc
checks.detail: Expired part and metadata files were removed by the storage janitor

checks.name: documentation_consistency
checks.detail: Dynamic test count, links, freshness rows, API version and retired-claim checks

checks.name: qemu_full_matrix_rerun
checks.detail: No QEMU controller or device probe changed in this upload/docs slice

notes: The current byte-scan upload backend is complete at the service/API layer, but the WebBurner browser UI remains open.
Core2 HCI-3a remains PASS; HCI-3b complete HCI/GATT and HCI-4 repeated lease remain open.
Network Linux policy CI is delivered; dual-device fabric, a self-hosted QEMU worker and external IPv6 remain open.
All device and network conclusions remain virtual-device validation, not physical hardware measurements.
